correctness.rationale: For f(x)=Lx+c on F_2^m, substitution into the characteristic-two Yang--Baxter functional equation gives (L+L^3)x+(I+L^2)c=0 for all x. Invertibility of L forces L^2=I and the constant term then vanishes; D=I+L obeys D^2=0 and rank(D)=r<=floor(m/2). For the specified helical carrier sweep, delta_j=Dx_j+Db_0+(j-1)Dc+c. Directly D(delta_j)=Dc=v and Db_N=Db_0+Nv, so delta_j(second)=delta_j+(N+1)v, giving T^2: sites translate by v exactly for even N, carrier fixed. This proves T^4=I for all m,N. A full state is fixed exactly when each delta_j=0, solvable precisely when c is in im D, then there are q(q/2^r)^N fixed full states. The primitive 1/2/4-cycle formulas follow. Square-zero matrices of rank r are classified by image U, kernel K containing U, and an isomorphism V/K->U, yielding [m choose r]_2 [m-r choose r]_2 |GL(r,2)|. m=4 counts (1,105,210), total 5056 maps and 3360 even-length all-period-four maps are arithmetically correct. Independent fresh exhaustive checks covered all invertible affine rules m=1,2,3 and all states through N=3 (through N=4 for m<=2), as well as all 65536 endomorphisms in m=4. Universal quantifiers follow analytically, not from these finite checks.

value.rationale: The complete primitive-period census for a canonical affine subclass of a contemporary finite-field integrable helical automaton is a mathematically motivated infinite-parameter classification. The relation between system parity, square-zero rank and affine translation, plus the criterion for all full states to have primitive period four, resolves exactly what the known qualitative maximum-period results and general-conjecture language do not. The rankwise family cardinalities allow structural counting of admissible rules. This is a natural exact invariant and not a low-dimensional finite-table repetition, although the ingredients and proof are elementary. It does not solve the nonlinear classification or claim new involution counts.
residual_risks: Scope restricted to additive-affine rules and complete states including carrier.
Some individual low-dimensional instances overlap the original small-field period statements; independent mathematical value lies in unrestricted complete classification.

limitations: Only additive-affine maps and complete full states are classified; nonlinear maps and site-only cycles are not classified.
Finite enumeration covers finite parameters; universal proof is algebraic.
